label: Hospitality
tagline: Keep a hotel's linen and minibar stock running
opening: You've joined the housekeeping team at **<<biz>>**. Guests expect fresh towels and full minibars, and today the store room is tracked on a clipboard. The supervisor wants a program that runs it.
rule: The supervisor's rule: when a supply item is down to **<<level>> or fewer**, restock it before the next shift.
scene: A manager radios: "Do we have <<n2>>?" Nobody should walk to the store room to count. The board needs a quick lookup, and it must cope with items you don't stock.

action.name: restock
action.doc: add the delivery to the pieces on hand

glossary: The stock a hotel aims to hold for each item.
The team that cleans rooms and keeps them supplied.
A small in-room fridge of drinks and snacks that must be refilled.
Preparing a room for the next guest.
The note that comes with a laundry delivery.
Money tied up in supplies: pieces times cost.
py_uses: Forecast how many towels and sheets each weekend needs
Check that kitchen freezers stayed cold overnight
Turn booking spreadsheets into a daily room-prep list
